question.question: How do Eyrie item crafting and its Builder leader interact with printed VP and extra crafting-point effects?

expected.expected_answer: Normally ignore printed VP and score one; extra crafting-point effects still apply. Builder ignores Disdain so printed VP applies.

source_passages.quotation: **Lords of the Forest:** Win ties for rule if at least one Eyrie piece there. **Disdain for Trade:** Crafted items score only **one VP instead of printed VP** (other extra crafting-point effects still apply). Builder ignores Disdain.
